ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels concentrated along the margins and in localized interior clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the center of both lobes. Black pigmentation is mapped to the lateral tips, the proximal edge of the trailing margin, and a vertical strip extending from the peduncle into the median notch area. Multiple small, low-intensity circular spots are distributed across the white field of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Pixel amplitude of peaks varies between 5 to 15 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges exhibit smooth convex curves tapering to sharp, upturned lateral tips. Trailing edges follow an overall concave arc heavily modified by serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast dark pixel clusters are visible near the base of the right lobe and along the interior trailing edges, consistent with localized scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the inner portion of the right lobe and the central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and scalloping of the trailing edge margins on both lobes.
